newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville Power price offers unchanged to Sat.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville Power price offers unchanged to Sat.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) left its next day price offers unchanged through Saturday, the agency said Thursday.

For both Friday and Saturday, BPA continued to offer block power during heavy-load hours at $18.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) in the Northwest and $19.50 at the California-Oregon (COB) and Nevada-Oregon (NOB) borders.
Off-peak firm sales for all deliveries were still offered at $15.00 per MWh.
Non-firm offers were also unchanged at $20.00 for peak California borders sales and at $18.50 for the Northwest.
BPA continued to offer non-firm power during light load and shoulder hours for deliveries in the Northwest and California border at $15.00-16.00.
